Borin Blackpick (LN) — Claimwarden

Borin is an aging prospector and the elected representative of the largest Blackpick camps. He has spent much of his life searching for the mines his ancestors abandoned, carrying a weathered collection of family deeds and survey maps that he guards more carefully than gold.
